_analysis_notes.summary: The current application uses a functional but relatively basic implementation of PrimeNG. The objective is to elevate the UI to a 'premium' feel by introducing a curated color palette, shared animations, dark mode support, and refined micro-interactions in the screening workflow.
important_constraints: Must use PrimeNG Aura theme as the base preset
Angular 21 standalone component architecture must be maintained
No external heavy animation libraries; use @angular/animations
assumptions: Backend provides scores in numeric format
PrimeIcons is already integrated and sufficient for current needs
risks: Dark mode might require manually overriding some PrimeNG variables if Aura preset defaults aren't enough
Complex CSS animations might impact scrolling performance on low-end devices

steps.title: Design System Initialization
steps.description: Define CSS custom properties in styles.scss for a harmonized color palette, glassmorphism utilities, and shared transition timings.
steps.validation: Check styles.scss for the new variable definitions.

steps.title: Dark Mode Infrastructure
steps.description: Create a ThemeService to handle dark/light mode persistence and toggle. Update app.config.ts to enable the darkModeSelector.
steps.validation: Verify that theme state is saved to localStorage and reflected in the document body class.

steps.title: Landing Page Aesthetic Overhaul
steps.description: Apply glassmorphism to the 'How it works' cards. Add reveal animations on scroll. Update the Hero section with a modern gradient background.
steps.validation: Visually inspect the landing page for 'wow' factor and smooth entrance animations.

steps.title: Analyze Component UX Refinement
steps.description: Improve the file drop zone with visual feedback on drag. Add a 'Clear All' button for selected files. Implement a multi-step loading indicator for the screening process.
steps.validation: Test file selection workflow and ensuring the loading state provides clear feedback.

steps.title: Results Visualization Polish
steps.description: Enhance candidate score bars with dynamic color gradients (e.g., green for high score, amber for medium). Implement staggering animations for list items.
steps.validation: Check results list for staggered appearance and intuitive score visualization.

steps.title: Universal Layout Polish
steps.description: Implement a shared Navbar with the theme toggle and consistent branding across all features. Ensure mobile responsiveness across all views.
steps.validation: Test the application on multiple screen sizes and verify the navbar presence on all routes.
